answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 12324 Country: India Title: A/k Whether a person of Hanafi maslak living in Saudi Arabia, can perform more than one Umrah in one journey as we have heard that Prophet PBUH prefferd one in each journey. Question: A/k Whether a person of Hanafi maslak living in Saudi Arabia, can perform more than one Umrah in one journey as we have heard that Prophet PBUH prefferd one in each journey. Answer ID: 12324 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 862/724=D/1430) The hadith speaks of the greater virtues of Umrah. It is emphasized Sunnah to perform Umrah once if one is able to do so, while performing Umrah excessively is mustahab. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) had many other necessary things, apart from Umrah, which he preferred: ویعتمر قبل الحج ما شاء، وفي اللباب: لا یعتمر قبل الحج فغیر صحیح غیر جدید (215 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
